messages:
maya: Heads-up — found a staging backup artifact that includes a Vault token in plain text and a KMS-wrapped blob. Not prod, but could be picked up by partner tooling if cached. Need a quick sweep + coordination. :eyes:
owen: path? can you paste object name (no token) so infra can search for copies?
julian: please do NOT paste the token. just filename and any hashes. we should check GCS access logs first.
maya: object: gs://partner-staging/backups/2026-03-20/backup.tgz. inside: config/.env contains VAULT_TOKEN=*** (truncated) and backups/wrapped_blob.bin (looks like KMS ciphertext). checksum CRC32C: r7lK9Q==
maya: I ran `gsutil ls -L gs://partner-staging/backups/2026-03-20/backup.tgz` and inspected metadata only. owner: serviceAccount:partner-ci-sa@partner-prod. lastAccess: 2026-03-20T14:12:22Z
julian: ok — first containment: rotate the exposed Vault token (scope limited to staging-service), and remove any broad IAM decrypt grants that partner-ci-sa might have. I'll also enable bucket-level audit export.
security-oncall: Agreed. Action items: 1) Maya rotate the Vault token and update staging env. 2) Owen verify and remove KMS decrypt binding for partner-ci-sa and create a short-lived conditional grant if needed. 3) Julian enable audit export + alert for public ACL changes. I will coordinate rewrap.
owen: checking IAM now. running: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter")'`
owen: confirmed partner-ci-sa has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on keyRing `projects/prod-keys/locations/us/keyRings/partner-keys`. I'll prepare a patch to remove and add conditional grant.
maya: rotating Vault token now. script: `vault token create -policy=staging-service -ttl=1h -wrap-ttl=5m` -> new token stored in internal secret manager and injected to staging via rollout. will scrub env copies and update ticket with scrub command.
julian: infra ticket IR-2026-134 created for audit export + alert. alert rule: GCS bucket public_acl OR newObjects with `metadata.containsKey("VAULT_TOKEN")` -> pagerduty critical. ETA 3h.
security-oncall: For rewrap, I'll spin up an ephemeral runner in infra project (ttl=2h) with the minimum IAM to decrypt/re-encrypt. Rewrap sketch:
```
# copy down
gsutil cp gs://partner-staging/backups/wrapped_blob.bin /tmp/wrapped_blob.bin
# rewrap (decrypt with old key + encrypt with new key)
python rewrap.py --in /tmp/wrapped_blob.bin --out /tmp/wrapped_blob.rewrapped \
  --decrypt-key projects/prod-keys/locations/us/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKey \
  --encrypt-key projects/prod-keys/locations/us/keyRings/partner-keys/newKey
# verify and upload
sha256sum /tmp/wrapped_blob.rewrapped
gsutil cp /tmp/wrapped_blob.rewrapped gs://partner-staging/backups/
```
owen: I'll remove the unconditional binding in ~15m and post the IAM diff here. plan is to add a conditional binding with `request.time` until we finish and then revoke.
maya: tagging @owen @julian to confirm. I'll also run a grep across recent CI artifacts for any other plain VAULT_TOKEN occurrences: `gsutil ls -r gs://partner-staging/** | xargs -n1 gsutil cat | grep -E 'VAULT_TOKEN='` then report matches to ticket — do not paste tokens here.
owen: IAM diff ready, posting snippet (sanitized):
```
- members: ["serviceAccount:partner-ci-sa@partner-prod"]
+ members: []
+ conditional grant: member serviceAccount:partner-ci-sa@partner-prod -> decrypt until 2026-03-21T18:30:00Z
```
julian: audit export enabled and rule created. infra-bot: IR-2026-134 created and alert rule ID alert-88321. infra-bot: ticket link https://phabricator.redwood/IR-2026-134
security-oncall: Rotation and rewrap in progress. I'll post completion and attach rewrap checksums and access log query results. :lock:
maya: rotation done — new Vault token injected to staging via secret manager, previous token revoked. scrubbed local copies and removed object replicas where found.
owen: conditional grant added and then revoked after rewrap completed. posted full before/after IAM export in the ticket.
security-oncall: Rewrap finished, checksum matches, no unauthorized decrypts observed in last 24h. No evidence of exfil to prod. Closing on our side once pagerduty alert is validated. :white_check_mark:
julian: please run one post-change smoke eval for staging auth flows. If all good, mark IR-2026-134 resolved.
maya: will run eval and post results in ticket. thanks everyone.
